title: Hoshino Ichika — Take Your Time〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry for making you all gather like this so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's okay.
You said you wanted to talk about something important?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I already messaged you all about my call with Mr. Shindo last night...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He told you about when Mr. Ota's gonna be free to see us play, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but we also discussed another important matter. I didn't mention that in my message because I wanted to talk about it with you all in person...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does it have to do with us losing our momentum?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, what did Mr. Shindo say...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Based on what you just told me... It sounds like your band is currently like an orchestra without a conductor.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <You're all looking to each other for clues as to what to do, which is causing you to lose focus.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<So, how do you solve that problem?
Simple...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Someone needs to step up and lead.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we are sort of trying to compensate for each other in not a great way...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That explains so much...!
No wonder we've been having so much trouble!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He said that we need someone to step up, lead and pull us in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So I decided to take on that role.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not discussing this with any of you first, but I thought this was my duty as the leader of this band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't want our audience to focus on us “making the most of our youth”.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The four of us want to play music that really moves people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We know that going pro means making some sacrifices.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, we want to be the ones who decide what we actually sacrifice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So that we can stay true to our feelings.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In other words, the onus is on you to keep your band together...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You'll need to have a strong leader who can keep everything from falling apart.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Honami.
If anything, I want you to lead us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I know it's not gonna be easy, but I believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The drummer is the foundation of the band, so I'm also glad you're volunteering, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Of course...!
I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As part of that, Mr. Shindo said that he wants to do some training with me to improve my drumming...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, I need to head out early today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Honami's doing what she can as the leader of our band...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Which means we need to follow her example.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, what were you two going to say?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Shiho, no jumping the gun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you just said, “You guys first.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but that's not what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, how about a game of rock paper scissors?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that we're all thinking the same thing...)
